textureSources.notes: Exact SKU exposed black PCB back. Outer contour, castellations and all visible through holes masked in original pixels; no source white background or central screw-end pixels remain. Board color/plane and true cutout geometry remain separate. Exterior source mask is the largest minRGB<225 contour, Douglas-Peucker0.65px and0.6px inward margin, intersected with projected mechanical outline; original silkscreen remains untouched. Explicit resulting polygon is retained for offline reproduction. Texture hole masks have a0.06mm safety inset beyond mechanical cutouts to prevent alpha-edge fragments floating over holes. The photographed plated annulus remains on its known exposed plane above the separately modeled thin annulus; its tiny markings are not synthesized.
